name: test
on: [push]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.1'
      - run: bundle install
      - run: bundle exec rake test

GEM
  remote: https://rubygems.org/
  specs:
    minitest (5.15.0)
    rake (13.0.6)

PLATFORMS
  x86_64-linux

DEPENDENCIES
  minitest (= 5.15.0)
  rake (= 13.0.6)

BUNDLED WITH
   2.3.27

require "rake/testtask"

Rake::TestTask.new(:test) do |t|
  t.libs << "test"
  t.pattern = "test/**/*_test.rb"
end

module Roman
  def self.call(n)
    %w[I II III IV V][n - 1]
  end
end

require 'minitest/autorun'
require_relative '../lib/roman'

class RomanTest < Minitest::Test
  def test_converts_four
    assert_equal 'IV', Roman.call(4)
  end
end
